$schema_note: Public outcomes record for the Steam Dataset 2025 v1.0.0 collection, measured 2026-11-13 from the retained raw batches. Every metric states its cohort, grain, numerator, denominator, state and limitations. Record success is never HTTP request success and never catalog coverage.

raw_corpus.description: Retained application batch files (unpublished raw corpus, read at its actual grain)
raw_corpus.evidence: Recount of 526 batch files on ml01a, 2026-11-13; private receipt sha256 5e44a850052aac951d1e4d468500faa536f0dbd65d8bbdf2852aa8811d5f1f1b

result_records.grain: one record per retained appdetails result
result_records.cohort: all records in all batch files

success_records.grain: records with success=true carrying a data payload

failure_records.grain: records with success=false and no data payload

unique_successful_appids.grain: distinct integer steam_appid among success records

duplicate_success_records.grain: success records repeating an already-seen appid

limitations: A record-level success fraction (91.0766% here) is neither HTTP request success nor unique-app catalog coverage; the denominator is retained result records, not attempts reconstructable as HTTP requests.
All failure records lack the requested AppID, so no per-application failure manifest exists and HTTP-attempt completeness cannot be measured from the retained corpus.
158 success records repeat an AppID already collected; unique successful AppIDs, not success records, are the raw-corpus population grain.

packaged_population.description: Population of the packaged v1.0.0 database as recorded at packaging time
limitations: These are packaging-time records, not a fresh verification of the released dump; the dump lane in this maintenance unit was deferred (see schema-provenance.json).

Raw unique successful AppIDs (239,183) and packaged applications rows (239,664) differ by 481; with the released dump unavailable this difference is unresolved and is NOT an established released-artifact join. No cause is asserted.

released_population.description: Actual AppID population of the released packages (dump/CSV)
released_population.reason: Verified-dump acquisition/decoding was unavailable in this maintenance unit (decoder path denied; no host client). Released-population facts are unverified with null measured values until a verified dump is decoded.
dependent_claims_removed_or_qualified: 90.8% catalog coverage claim (removed; no authoritative denominator)
56%/134,212 success-rate family (replaced by raw-corpus record-level outcomes above)
Any raw-vs-released reconciliation or lineage claim (qualified as unresolved 481 difference)

review_corpus.state: corroborated-by-packaging-record; sampling bound from dated 2026-08-03 measurement
review_corpus.sampling: Bounded per-application sample (up to 100 most recent English-language reviews per covered application; 117,311 covered applications per the 2026-08-03 read-only measurement), not a complete historical corpus.
